data.name: Squidview
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to White Shell Island, a diverse, tropical landscape. You have just received an invite to a fresh start in paradise. On arrival, you realize the island has so much more to offer than you had originally thought. Design your islander, purchase outfits and find your unique style, chat with dozens of interesting islanders, pursue romances, cook dishes, plant crops, fish, discover hobbies, make money in honorable or dishonorable ways, buy different plots, and decorate your dream house.

Live however you see fit... The world is in your hands!

Miss Shell has sent you an invitation to live on White Shell Island, to meet creative individuals and follow your passion. You see this offer as an escape from Gray Hills, the dull, lifeless mainland. Maybe this is the life you've always imagined. Will you live as a flirtatious charmer, a prosperous criminal, a struggling pizza carrier, or even just a gardener? 

Explore 7 different regions of the open world on White Shell Island, including Squidview City, Turtle Coast, White Shell Village, Moonlight Peake, Sage Woods, Crystal Plains, and Firefly Fields!

Features:

  • Islander Customization (including a detailed portrait)

  • Fashionable Outfits & Hairstyles

  • Multiple Purchasable & Rentable Plots & Houses

  • A Variety of Decorations

  • Friendly and Romantic Relationships with Islanders

  • Dating, Hangout, & Marriage System

  • Experimental Cooking System

  • Unique Fishing System

  • Simple Gardening System

  • Different Ways to Earn Money (listed jobs and Marketplace to sell goods)

  • Amusing Quests & Rewards

  • Events, Holidays, & Parties

  • Standard & Special Skills

    • Cooking

    • Gardening

    • Fishing

    • Fitness

    • Eco-Friendliness

    • and more!

  • Seasons & Weather

  • Personality System

  • Collections

Upcoming Features:

  • Household & Exotic Pets

  • University & Sports

  • Tattoos & Piercings

  • Beach Resort

  • Campsite

  • Cinema & Filming Studio

  • Music Store

  • Criminals & Law Enforcement

  • Bounty Hunting

  • Science Laboratory & Experiments 

  • Vehicles & Vehicle Customization

  • Custom Events

  • Businesses

  • Clubs & Cliques

  • 150+ Additional Islanders

  • More Jobs & Careers

  • More Activities

    • Karaoke

    • Gaming

    • Clubbing

    • Skating

    • and more!

  • More Foods, Fish, Plants, Decor Items, Houses, Personalities, Events, & Quests

  • and so much more!
